evidence.summary: The baseline contract omits absent diagnostic debugLabel from JSON.
Emitted request/call pairs each have one result before that request's done; cross-request interleaving is not specified.
Approved ticket UX-42 explicitly changes only absent debugLabel to serialized null in b28.
Baseline two-request trace has r1/c1 call, r2/c2 call, r1/c1 result, r1 done, r2/c2 result, r2 done.
Candidate two-request trace has r2/c2 call, r1/c1 call, r2/c2 result, r2 done, r1/c1 result, r1 done.
The supplied scope is only debugLabel and the listed per-request traces; no test-oracle changes or performance results are claimed.

checks.contract: At baseline, absent diagnostic debugLabel is omitted from JSON; UX-42 explicitly changes only this absent debugLabel behavior to serialize null in b28.
checks.baseline: Contract C1 and observation O1 establish response {} for absent-debug at a17.
checks.candidate: Observation N1 establishes b28 response {"debugLabel":null}; approval A1 applies exactly to absent debugLabel serialization.

checks.contract: For each request/call pair, one result must occur before that request's done; cross-request interleaving is not specified.
checks.baseline: Observation O2 shows r1/c1 result before r1 done and r2/c2 result before r2 done.
checks.candidate: Observation N2 also shows r2/c2 result before r2 done and r1/c1 result before r1 done; the changed cross-request interleaving is outside the specified order.

nextTests.action: Add scoped regression coverage that only absent diagnostic debugLabel serializes as null and no other absent JSON fields are normalized under UX-42.
nextTests.expected: Absent debugLabel yields {"debugLabel":null}; unrelated absent fields continue to follow their own baseline contracts.

nextTests.action: Exercise multiple concurrent requests with distinct call IDs and verify one result per emitted call before each request's done while allowing cross-request interleaving.
nextTests.expected: Each emitted request/call pair has exactly one matching result before that request's done, with no global ordering requirement between independent requests.

verdict.reason: The only observed behavior change is absent debugLabel serialization from omission to null, and that change has a scoped approval. The supplied per-request traces match the specified per-request result-before-done contract despite different cross-request interleaving. This scoped review is not release approval.
